results.note: cron changed from '17 */6 * * *' to '17 0 * * *' (ingest.yml:5) and the run step now invokes `uv run python -m ingest.heartbeat --tier daily` (ingest.yml:43), asserted by the new tests/test_ingest_workflow.py tests, which ran green in the US-1202-C6 gate (289 passed).

The workflow only adds `--tier daily` to the existing CLI (ingest.yml:43); heartbeat.py's argparse (heartbeat.py:87) and run_ingestion (heartbeat.py:42-58) pass tier straight through to run_scheduled_board -> run_all_assets, whose filter (`definition.expected_update_interval_seconds == TIER_INTERVAL_SECONDS[tier]`, pipeline.py:362-365) is US-1201's unmodified filter — this diff touches none of registry.py or pipeline.py, only the workflow file and a new assertion-only test file.

Job name, permissions, checkout/setup-python/setup-uv steps, and the HEALTHCHECKS_PING_URL/DATABASE_URL env wiring are byte-identical to before; the diff only touches the cron line and the run command line, and the 17-minute offset (GitHub's recommended anti-congestion practice) is explicitly preserved and tested.

No test drives the actual entry point end to end: test_ingest_workflow.py only string-matches the YAML text, it never calls heartbeat.main. The only test that parses `--tier` via heartbeat.main (test_main_accepts_tier_argument in tests/test_heartbeat.py:201) uses 'fast' and monkeypatches run_ingestion itself away, so it never reaches the real run_scheduled_board -> run_all_assets tier filter. The unmocked daily-tier test (test_scheduled_daily_tier_keeps_existing_sol_active_addresses_exclusion, tests/test_persist_board.py:357-389, pre-existing from US-1201) calls run_scheduled_board(tier='daily') directly, bypassing the CLI/argparse entry point entirely. Nothing in this diff connects `python -m ingest.heartbeat --tier daily` argument parsing to the real (unmocked) filtering/persist pipeline.

The test reads WORKFLOW = Path('.github/workflows/ingest.yml') directly — the real production workflow file GitHub Actions schedules from, not a copied/local approximation — and asserts its exact cron and run-command strings; this is the closest verifiable proxy short of an actual scheduled GitHub Actions run.
Deterministic gate 'US-1202-C6: uv run pytest -q' exits 0 with 289 passed, 29 deselected, as supplied in the gate results.

note: 5 of 6 criteria hold up under direct reading of the code and tests. C4 fails: the only tests touching the CLI --tier flag either mock run_ingestion away (test_main_accepts_tier_argument, 'fast' only) or call run_scheduled_board(tier='daily') directly, bypassing argparse/heartbeat.main — no test exercises the actual cron entry point (`python -m ingest.heartbeat --tier daily`) end to end through the real, unmocked filter/persist pipeline. The new test_ingest_workflow.py is a static text check on the YAML, not an integration test.
